title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Evaluation of the Deception Detection Capabilities of LLMs in Multimodal Settings

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the post-hoc reasoning generated by LLMs to identify their over-reliance on specific linguistic cues (such as specificity, vagueness, hesitation, justification, and emotional expressions) as proxies for truthfulness or deception, leading to overgeneralization and misclassification.

Comparing few-shot model performance on a dataset with a known data-origin confound (OpSpam, where deceptive reviews were crowdsourced and truthful ones were scraped) against a rigorously controlled alternative dataset (Prolific) to determine if models exploit dataset-specific stylistic artifacts rather than true deception cues.
